run_sentence_splitter: run the SentenceSplitter on a PyArrow table to split text columns into sentences using the SaT model
run_full_pipeline: run the FullPipeline to split text into sentences and compute Sonar embeddings in one pass
create_sentence_splitter_config: create a SentenceSplitterConfig with custom model name, sentence threshold, and max sentence length settings
resplit_long_sentences: resplit sentences exceeding max_sentence_len using the SaT model probability predictions and fallback separators
merge_small_intervals: merge small intervals in a numpy array of lengths where values below min_merging_length are combined up to max_merge_length
